facts: The Oakley page describes a large, free on-site parking lot and additional free spaces reached by the Madison Road bridge and crosswalk. It does not state the connection’s distance, gradient or kerb details.

MadTree’s Oakley Taproom has a large, free, dedicated parking lot right on-site for our guests, complete with electric car charging stations. There are hundreds of additional free spots accessible by the Madison Rd. bridge and crosswalk.

MadTree’s FAQ says Oakley taproom and beer-garden seating is generally first come, first served. Space can be reserved for larger parties of 10–30 people; this does not establish a particular table or wheelchair-space layout.
Oakley Taproom: Generally, all seating is first come, first served in the very large taproom and beer garden. However, we happily reserve space for larger parties of 10 - 30 people.
The Oakley page says its in-house kitchen offers vegetarian and gluten-free menu items. These menu labels do not establish how cross-contact is handled; discuss requirements before ordering.
Our in-house kitchen serves a full menu featuring pizzas, sandwiches, fresh salads, and shareable snacks enjoy — including vegetarian and gluten-free items.
The FAQ says dogs at Oakley must stay on the outdoor patio. It does not explain service-animal arrangements.
MadTree's Oakley Taproom is dog-friendly. All dogs must remain on the outdoor patio.
